text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yay! First place, I got first place!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, maybe it's because of the short 
distance? It was over in the blink of an 
eye!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And then, I was right up in front before I 
knew it! It felt so good~♪
choice_data_list: Don't be nervous, you did great!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
choice_data_list: Felt different than usual, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "Not at all! It was as fun as always!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Every race is fun to me! So all I gotta 
do is give it my best!"

Being able to stay her usual self no 
matter what race lies ahead. While I 
believe that is a strong weapon for Haru 
Urara...

Tension can sometimes produce great 
results. So, I decided to suggest entering 
an even higher-level race—
choice_data_list: How about entering a G1 next?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That's such a cool nameー! Alright! I'll 
enter, I'll totally enterー!

If she enters a race where everyone is 
running seriously, it might just change 
Haru Urara's mindset!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
February... wait, what was that again? I 
feel like I learned it, but I totally 
forgot!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I wanna run in the "Febyubawwy 
Stakes"!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh? Long names are so hard~.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Feb-roo-ary, Feb... rary, Felibury...? I 
don't get it anymoreee!

"...Our next target race has been decided. 
However—"

Haru Urara doesn't seem to take things 
very seriously. Just how far will she be 
able to go?
